translation: (Lycium 枸杞 [and] ... is/are averse to dried ginger 乾薑, is/are in dread of achyranthes 牛膝 and 乾漆, and is/are incompatible with aconite 烏頭.) Original text of the Benjing: Trichosanthes root (栝蔞根), flavor bitter, cold. It chiefly treats wasting-thirst and body heat, vexation and fullness with great heat, supplements vacuity and calms the center, and rejoins severed injuries.
